summary: Arthur Waley worked in Sinology, Japanology, and Buddhist studies. He studied at King's College, Cambridge (1907-1910) and under Gustav Haloun, Laurence Binyon, and Hidetsugu Yagi. He served at the British Museum (1913-1929) and SOAS University of London (1948).

Arthur Wilhelm Gleye was a linguist who earned his Ph.D. at the University of Tartu (studying 1888-1891 and ~1887-1893 under Leo Meyer). He served as a Lecturer of German at Tomsk State University from 1901 to 1921.

Arthur William Ryder was an Indologist. He studied at Harvard under Charles Rockwell Lanman and earned his doctorate at Leipzig under Ernst Windisch, also studying at Berlin. He taught at Harvard (1901-1906) and the University of California (~1906-1938).
Arthur Woollgar Verrall was a scholar who studied at Wellington College (~1864-1869) and Trinity College, Cambridge (~1869-1873).

Arti Dhand works in religious studies and Indology. She studied at the University of Calgary (~1985-1993) and McGill University (~1994-2000), and became an Associate Professor at the University of Toronto (~2002).

Artur Kibat specialized in Indology and linguistics. He studied at the University of Königsberg (1898-1904, Ph.D.) under Adalbert Bezzenberger, and worked as a teacher at Oberrealschule Wilhelmshaven in 1910.
Aruna Haldar was a scholar of Indology and philosophy. She studied under Kedarnath Ojha and Girindrasekhar Bose, and taught at Patna University.

Indologist Arunoday Natvarlal Jani completed his Ph.D. at the University of Mumbai (~1946-1953) under Govindlal Hargovind Bhatt. He served as professor and Sanskrit department head at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda and directed the Oriental Institute, Vadodara (1975-1981).

Arvind Sharma works in Indology, religious studies, and philosophy. He studied at Allahabad, Syracuse, and Harvard. He held posts at the University of Queensland (1976), the University of Sydney (1980), and McGill University as Birks Chair in Comparative Religion (1994).
Aryadeva was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Nagarjuna and Shakyamitra. He held a post at the Mithila Institute of Post-Graduate Studies and Research in Sanskrit Learning.
Aryendra Sharma was an Indologist and linguist who completed his doctoral studies under Walther Wüst by 1939. He served as Director at Osmania University, attested in 1969.

Asanga Tilakaratne works in Buddhist studies and philosophy. Educated at the University of Peradeniya and University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, he held professorships at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies and the University of Colombo (~2009-2017).
Asatoshi Kamiya studied Buddhist studies, earning an M.A. at Komazawa University (attested 1973). He served as a teacher at Mejiro Kenshin High School (attested 1978).

Aschwin Lippe was a scholar of Indology, Sinology, and history/archaeology. He earned a Ph.D. at Humboldt University of Berlin (~1934-1942), served as a curator at the Metropolitan Museum of Art (1949-1973), and was a curator at the University of Paris (1980).

Asen Balikci worked in history and archaeology, earning a PhD from Columbia University (1956). He held posts at the Canadian Museum of History (1954), the National Museum of Canada (~1957-1963), and the Université de Montréal (1963-1993).

Ashok Aklujkar specializes in Indology, linguistics, and philosophy. He studied at Savitribai Phule Pune University and completed a Ph.D. at Harvard University (~1965-1970) under Daniel H. H. Ingalls. He served at the University of British Columbia (1969-2006).

Ashok Kumar Chatterjee specialized in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He completed his B.A., M.A., and Ph.D. at Banaras Hindu University under T. R. V. Murti, later chairing philosophy departments at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University and Banaras Hindu University.
Ashok Kumar Malhotra works in philosophy and Indology. He studied at the East-West Center from ~1964 to 1966 and founded the Yoga and Meditation Society for the Scientific Study of Spirituality.

Ashok Ramchandra Kelkar was a linguist and Indologist. He studied at Savitribai Phule Pune University and Cornell University, later holding posts at Pune, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University, and the Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (~1967-1989).

Ashoka Welitota works in Buddhist studies. He held posts as Senior Lecturer Gr. II at the University of Kelaniya in 2016 and as Senior Lecturer at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies (attested 2026).
